title: Reading Time Calculator
h1: Reading Time Calculator — Words per Minute Estimate
seoTitle: Reading Time Calculator — Words per Minute
description: Estimate how long a passage takes to read from word count and a words-per-minute pace. Useful for blogs, essays and scripts. Runs in your browser.
intro: Paste any text and set a reading pace. The calculator counts words and estimates minutes and seconds at that speed, with a speaking-time comparison.
blurb: Estimate reading time from word count and a words-per-minute pace.

controls.label: Text
controls.placeholder: Paste an article, essay or script

controls.label: Reading pace (words per minute)
controls.help: Average adult silent reading is often cited around 200–250 wpm.

howItWorks: Paste the passage you want to time. Empty lines are ignored for the word count.
Set words per minute. 238 is a common silent-reading average; use about 150 for a presentation.
Press Estimate reading time. Minutes and seconds are words divided by your pace.
examples: 238 words at 238 wpm is about 1 minute 0 seconds.
500 words at 200 wpm is 2 minutes 30 seconds.
A 1,200-word post at 250 wpm is 4 minutes 48 seconds.

faq.a: For silent blog reading, 200 to 250 words per minute is a practical range. Aloud narration is slower, often 130 to 160 words per minute.
Words are split on whitespace. Punctuation attached to a word stays with that word, so the count matches a typical article word counter.
No. Counting and division happen in the page. Closing the tab clears the text.
